required_sources.quote: The sole permitted activity involving Protected Material is assessing the proposed commercial relationship between the companies; using it for any different activity is forbidden.
A Receiver is bound to keep Protected Material secret for eighteen months from the disclosure in question.
No later than fourteen calendar days following the disclosing company's request, the Receiver must send back or destroy every copy of Protected Material.
Where disclosure is compelled by law, the Receiver shall notify the disclosing company in writing before disclosure to the extent legally permitted.
A Receiver must not use residual information retained in unaided memory.
Before either company transfers this Agreement by assignment, it must obtain the other company's written consent.
The laws of Ontario, Canada govern this Agreement.

Only representatives who need the information to carry out the permitted evaluation may see it. Each Receiver is responsible for any failure of its representatives to obey these confidentiality duties.
